mainText:
Good morning. Weather in Prishtina: 10 degrees now, light rain. Next 24 hours: high 10, low 4.

The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration ordered a nationwide grounding of all flights, the first total suspension since the September 11 attacks.

Kosovo police extradited a Kosovar citizen from Italy who was wanted under an international arrest warrant for assisting murder bosses.

A British Airways Airbus clipped the runway with its wing tip while attempting to land at London Heathrow, prompting an emergency response.

Albanian environmental inspectors seized six excavators suspected of illegal sand extraction along the White Drin River.

Spain's football disciplinary committee banned Andorran goalkeeper Jesús Owono for 12 matches after he violently assaulted and caused the death of Jesús De Miguel during a match against Tenerife.
